svg.title: How Kusto query acceleration reads an external Delta table
svg.desc: Writers add Parquet files and Delta log commits in Azure Storage. Kusto polls the Delta log, downloads new Parquet files as its managed identity, and caches the rows as accelerated extents that queries read. The storage account logs every read to Log Analytics, minutes later.
svg.text: How Kusto query acceleration (QAP) reads a Delta table
Writers and Kusto never talk to each other. Kusto watches the Delta log and copies Parquet data into its hot cache.
extent 1 · rows of A B C
extent 2 · rows of D E F
logs every blob read: who, which file, how many bytes
Writers add Parquet files and a commit to _delta_log.
Kusto polls the log (at most MaxAge old) for the file list.
It downloads new files (GetBlob) as its managed identity.
It packs the rows into extents in its hot cache.
Queries read the extents, not the lake.
Storage logs every read; Log Analytics shows it later.
